description: React component implementing the Direct Trajectory panel, including role recommendation, selection, saving, and rendering of related roadmap and gap analysis.

methods.name: normString
methods.description: Converts an unknown value to a trimmed string, safely handling null or undefined.

methods.name: safeStringArray
methods.description: Ensures the input is an array of strings, normalizing each element.

methods.name: roleIdFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role ID string from a role object, handling multiple possible property names.

methods.name: roleTitleFromRole
methods.description: Extracts a role title string from a role object.

methods.name: horizonWeeks
methods.description: Returns an approximate number of weeks based on the selected time horizon.

methods.name: horizonLabel
methods.description: Returns a human-readable label for the specified time horizon.

methods.name: intersectSet
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two string sets, case-insensitive and trimmed.

methods.name: differenceSet
methods.description: Returns elements in 'required' not present in 'have', case-insensitive and trimmed.

methods.name: extractPersonaSkills
methods.description: Collects and deduplicates skills from persona data across multiple schema paths.

methods.name: extractRequiredSkills
methods.description: Extracts required skills from a role object.
